metadata.note: Deterministic demonstration scenarios designed for Part 4 verification and automated testing.

scenarios.title: Suspension Bridge B Complete Failure
scenarios.description: Suspension Bridge B connecting Settlement B (Tallo Gaun, 20 households) over the river gorge is washed out during torrential monsoon flooding. Settlement B has no alternative vehicular or pedestrian connection.

scenarios.title: Bridge Failure with Mountain Ridge Detour Active
scenarios.description: Bridge B is impassable, but an arduous high-elevation ridge footpath connecting Settlement B to Settlement A remains passable. Travel time increases significantly.

scenarios.title: Parallel Road Failure with Redundant Route Intact
scenarios.description: A primary road segment between Settlement A and Central Junction is blocked by minor rockfall, but a parallel bypass connector exists with identical or similar travel time.

scenarios.title: Already Disconnected Remote Settlement
scenarios.description: Remote Tol (15 households) was already unmapped or disconnected from the road network before the simulation. When another road fails, the algorithm must not falsely count Remote Tol as newly disconnected.

repair_comparison.title: What If We Fix This First?
repair_comparison.officer_decision_note: A municipal official must make the final decision based on local priorities and seasonal monsoon flood risks rather than cost estimates alone.
